header.title: StaggerGroup
header.description: Sequential enter / exit cascade for lists and grids. Each child starts after `staggerDelay` × order (plus optional `delay`). `from` (`top` / `bottom` / `left` / `right`) sets the slide edge; `distance` is the offset. `staggerDirection` (`1` | `-1`) sets enter order; `staggerShuffled` randomizes it per enter cycle. `reverseExit` (default true) flips that order on exit. `onItemEnter` fires per child when its enter delay elapses. Toggle `isIn`; the group stays mounted until the last item’s exit ends.

forwardExit.title: Forward exit
forwardExit.description: `reverseExit={false}` — exit uses the same order as enter (first item leaves first).

preserveSpace.title: Preserve space
preserveSpace.description: With `preserveSpace`, the group stays mounted when out and keeps its max layout size. The presence trigger stays start-aligned unless `center` is on.

direction.title: staggerDirection -1
direction.description: `staggerDirection={-1}` — enter starts from the last DOM child. With default `reverseExit`, exit flips that cascade again.

fromSides.title: from left / right
fromSides.description: `from` picks the slide edge (`left` / `right` / `top` / `bottom`). Default is `bottom`. Use the playground to flip edges.

onItemEnter.title: onItemEnter
onItemEnter.description: `onItemEnter` fires with each child’s DOM index when that item’s enter delay elapses.

directionItemEnter.title: direction -1 + onItemEnter
directionItemEnter.description: Reverse cascade: indices should arrive last→first (e.g. `4 → 3 → 2 → 1 → 0`).

shuffled.title: staggerShuffled
shuffled.description: `staggerShuffled` picks a random cascade order each time the group enters (Fisher–Yates). Toggle a few times — the index sequence should change. Exit still respects `reverseExit`.

header.title: StaggerGroup API
header.description: Reference for props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `StaggerGroup`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for cascade, from, direction, and onItemEnter.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/stagger-group` with its `stagger-group.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. Each child is decorated as an item with delay. Motion is opacity + translate3d along from.

items.presence: This is presence: the control that changes isIn should reflect state. Do not convey information with the cascade alone.
items.cascade: Visual order depends on staggerDirection / staggerShuffled. Do not use motion order as the only cue.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the group snaps to the final state with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion. Only if motion is essential.
items.preserveSpace: With preserveSpace items stay in flow at opacity 0. They should not receive focus or announcements while out.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a semantic host (ul, ol, div): that element is the cascade container.

items.item: Each child decorated with delay / opacity / transform.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written on the host and per item from timing.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables the CSS uses as defaults.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Duration, delay, and stagger per phase.

state.title: State
state.description: How the animation is turned off.

items.children: List or grid items. Each child is staggered in DOM order.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child. That child is the host.
items.isIn: `true` (default) plays enter; `false` plays exit and unmounts when done (unless `preserveSpace`).
items.from: Slide edge on enter (and toward on exit). Default `bottom`.
items.staggerDirection: `1` = DOM order; `-1` = reverse. Ignored with `staggerShuffled`. Default `1`.
items.staggerShuffled: Assigns a random order per enter cycle (Fisher–Yates). `reverseExit` still flips on exit.
items.reverseExit: `true` (default) reverses enter order on exit (last-in first-out).
items.preserveSpace: Stays mounted when out and keeps max layout size (opacity 0 in flow).
items.center: Centers children on the cross axis (`align-items: center`).
items.delay: Wait before the first item. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.staggerDelay: Extra between consecutive items. Default `50`. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.easing: Token, timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default `standard`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the target state with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onItemEnter: Per item when its enter starts (after its delay). Receives the DOM index.
items.outStagger: When the cascade exits (`isIn` false, disable, or unmount).
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with `--gemst-stagger-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
